description: Search Loafy's library of answers to real questions from bakers, written by Hendrik Kleinwächter of The Bread Code and grounded in his book The Sourdough Framework. Returns the answers that match, each with the book chapter behind it and a link. When none matches, returns the closest passages from the book instead. The library covers starters, fermentation, dough, flour, baking and storage, and it is in English. The book itself is search_sourdough_book for passages and read_sourdough_book for a whole chapter. Without a Loafy account, reading and searching the book and the answers is limited to 3 questions a day, every lookup within 15 minutes counting as one question; with an account it has no limit. The calculators, the guides and the book's table of contents need no account.

limit.description: How many answers to return. Defaults to 3.

query.description: What the baker wants to know, in English, e.g. "my starter smells like vinegar".

name: find_sourdough_answer

outputSchema.description: Answers to real questions from bakers.

input.description: The arguments as the tool used them, after any correction.

license.description: The licence of the book's text: CC BY-SA 4.0, with attribution.

note.description: A remark on the whole result, such as why nothing was found.

notes.description: What was corrected or left out, such as a value outside its range.

passages.description: When no answer matches, the closest passages from the book.

part.description: Its number and title, which read_sourdough_book takes.

url.description: The chapter on the book's website.

suggestion.description: Where to look next when nothing fits.

url.description: The same answer, recipe or entry on loafy.ai.

title: Find a sourdough answer
